```{r dataIPD, include=FALSE}

dataIPD <- merged_imp 


dataIPD <- dataIPD %>%

  rename(treatment = arm) %>%

  mutate(treatment = as.numeric(treatment))


dataIPD <- dataIPD %>%

  group_by(trialname) %>%

  arrange(treatment) %>%

  mutate(arm = as.numeric(factor(treatment,

                                 levels = unique(treatment)[order(unique(treatment))]))) %>%

  ungroup()


table(dataIPD$trialname, dataIPD$treatment)

table(dataIPD$trialname, dataIPD$arm)

table(dataIPD$treatment, dataIPD$arm)


components <- c("TAU", "PE", "CR", "ACC", "REL", "PM", "BA", "SSS", "IF")

Nc <- length(components)


y.ipd <- dataIPD$endpoint 
Npatients <- nrow(dataIPD)

studiesIPD_unique <- unique(dataIPD$trialname)
Ns.IPD <- length(studiesIPD_unique)


dataIPD$studlab <- as.numeric(factor(dataIPD$trialname, levels = studiesIPD_unique))

studyIPD <- dataIPD$studlab 

dataIPD$comb <- ""

for (i in 1:Npatients) {

  for (j in which(colnames(dataIPD) == "TAU"):which(colnames(dataIPD) == "IF")) {

    if (dataIPD[i, j] == "1") {

      dataIPD$comb[i] <- paste(dataIPD$comb[i], "+", colnames(dataIPD)[j])

    }

  }

}

dataIPD$comb <- substr(dataIPD$comb, 4, nchar(dataIPD$comb))


armIPD <- dataIPD$arm

unique_arm_combinations <- dataIPD %>%
  group_by(studlab, arm) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

for (i in 1:Nc) {
  component_name <- components[i]

  if (is.factor(unique_arm_combinations[[component_name]])) {
    unique_arm_combinations[[component_name]] <- as.numeric(as.character(unique_arm_combinations[[component_name]]))
  }

  temp_data_for_pivot <- unique_arm_combinations[, c("studlab", "arm", component_name)]

  temp_cIPD <- temp_data_for_pivot %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = !!sym(component_name), names_prefix = "arm_")

  cols_to_select <- names(temp_cIPD)[startsWith(names(temp_cIPD), "arm_")]
  assign(paste0("cIPD_", i), as.matrix(temp_cIPD[, cols_to_select]))
}

```

```{r standardize, include=FALSE}

dataIPD$age <- as.vector(scale(dataIPD$age))

dataIPD$empl_bin <- as.vector(scale(as.numeric(dataIPD$empl_bin)))

dataIPD$stc_bin <- as.vector(scale(as.numeric(dataIPD$stc_bin)))

dataIPD$gender <- as.vector(scale(as.numeric(as.character(dataIPD$gender))))

dataIPD$edu_bin <- as.vector(scale(as.numeric(dataIPD$edu_bin)))
dataIPD <- dataIPD %>%

  group_by(trialname) %>%

  mutate(

    cluster_id_within_study = if (all(is.na(cluster)) | n_distinct(cluster) == 1) {

      as.integer(rep(1, n()))

    } else {

      as.integer(factor(cluster, levels = unique(cluster)))

    },

    n_clusters_within_study = n_distinct(cluster_id_within_study)

  ) %>%

  ungroup()


dataIPD$y <- dataIPD$endpoint 

dataIPD$clusterIPD <- dataIPD$cluster_id_within_study
```

```{r model, include=FALSE}
model1_con_AD_common_pct <- "
model {
  prec.pat <- 1 / (sigma * sigma)
  sigma ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)I(0,) # Prior for residual standard deviation (IPD)

  for (s in 1:Ns.IPD) { 
    for (a in 1:2) { 
      phi.IPD[s, a] <- u[s] +
                         d[2] * cIPD_2[s, a] +
                         d[3] * cIPD_3[s, a] +
                         d[4] * cIPD_4[s, a] +
                         d[5] * cIPD_5[s, a] +
                         d[6] * cIPD_6[s, a] +
                         d[7] * cIPD_7[s, a] +
                         d[8] * cIPD_8[s, a] +
                         d[9] * cIPD_9[s, a]
    }
  }

  for (i in 1:Npatients) {
    y.ipd[i] ~ dnorm(muIPD[i], prec.pat)
    muIPD[i] <- phi.IPD[studyIPD[i], arm[i]] +
    cluster.effect[clusterID[i]] * cluster_indicator[studyIPD[i]] +
                  beta.baseline * baseline[i] +
                  beta.age * age[i] +
                  beta.gender * gender[i] +
                  beta.empl_bin * empl_bin[i] +
                  beta.stc_bin * stc_bin[i] +
                  beta.edu_bin * edu_bin[i] +
              
                  ( gamma.base[2] * cIPD_2[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] +
                   gamma.base[3] * cIPD_3[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] + gamma.base[4] * cIPD_4[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] + gamma.base[5] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] + gamma.base[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] + gamma.base[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] + gamma.base[8] * cIPD_8[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* baseline[i] + gamma.base[9] * cIPD_4[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[5] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[8] * cIPD_8[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[9] * cIPD_9[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* gender[i] +  gamma.empl_bin[2] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],arm[i]]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[8] * * cIPD_9[studyIPD[i],1]* age[i] + gamma.gender[2] * cIPD_2[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[3] * cIPD_3[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[4] * cIPD_4[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[5] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[8] * cIPD_8[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] + gamma.gender[9] * cIPD_9[studyIPD[i],1]* gender[i] +  gamma.empl_bin[2] * cIPD_2[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[3] * cIPD_3[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[4] * cIPD_4[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[5] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[8] * cIPD_8[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.empl_bin[9] * cIPD_9[studyIPD[i],1]* empl_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[2] * cIPD_2[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[3] * cIPD_3[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[4] * cIPD_4[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[5] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[8] * cIPD_8[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.stc_bin[9] * cIPD_9[studyIPD[i],1]* stc_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[2] * cIPD_2[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[3] * cIPD_3[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[4] * cIPD_4[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[5] * cIPD_5[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[6] * cIPD_6[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[7] * cIPD_7[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[8] * cIPD_8[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] + gamma.edu_bin[9] * cIPD_9[studyIPD[i],1]* edu_bin[i] )
  }

  for (s in 1:Ns.IPD) {
    delta1[s, 1] <- 0 
    delta1[s, 2] ~ dnorm(md1IPD[s, 2], prect)
    md1IPD[s, 2] <- (d[2] * cIPD_2[s,2] + d[3] * cIPD_3[s,2] + d[4] * cIPD_4[s,2] + d[5] * cIPD_5[s,2] + d[6] * cIPD_6[s,2] + d[7] * cIPD_7[s,2] + d[8] * cIPD_8[s,2] + d[9] * cIPD_9[s,2]) -
                    (d[2] * cIPD_2[s,1] + d[3] * cIPD_3[s,1] + d[4] * cIPD_4[s,1] + d[5] * cIPD_5[s,1] + d[6] * cIPD_6[s,1] + d[7] * cIPD_7[s,1] + d[8] * cIPD_8[s,1] + d[9] * cIPD_9[s,1])
  }

  for (s in 1:Ns) {
    for (a in 1:2) { 
      y[s, a] ~ dnorm(muAD[s, a], precisionAD[s, a])
      muAD[s, a] <- u[Ns.IPD + s] + deltaAD[s, a] 
      precisionAD[s, a] <- n[s, a] / (sd[s, a] * sd[s, a])
    }

    deltaAD[s, 1] <- 0
    
deltaAD[s, 2] ~ dnorm(mdAD[s], prec.total.AD)
    mdAD[s] <- (d[2] * c2[s, 2] + d[3] * c3[s, 2] + d[4] * c4[s, 2] +
                d[5] * c5[s, 2] + d[6] * c6[s, 2] + d[7] * c7[s, 2] +
                d[8] * c8[s, 2] + d[9] * c9[s, 2]) -
               (d[2] * c2[s, 1] + d[3] * c3[s, 1] + d[4] * c4[s, 1] +
                d[5] * c5[s, 1] + d[6] * c6[s, 1] + d[7] * c7[s, 1] +
                d[8] * c8[s, 1] + d[9] * c9[s, 1])
  }

  for (idx in 1:(Ns.IPD + Ns)) {
    u[idx] ~ dnorm(0, prec.u)
  }
  tau.u ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)I(0,)
  prec.u <- 1 / pow(tau.u, 2) 

  tau ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)I(0,) 
  tau.sq <- pow(tau, 2)
  prect <- 1 / tau.sq

  tau.AD.extra ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)I(0,) # Prior per la std dev dell'eterogeneità AD
tau.AD.extra.sq <- pow(tau.AD.extra, 2) # Varianza aggiuntiva per AD
prec.total.AD <- 1 / (tau.sq + tau.AD.extra.sq) # Precisione totale per AD

    tau.cluster.common ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)I(0,)
  prec.cluster.common <- 1 / pow(tau.cluster.common, 2)


 for (j in 1:Nclusters) { 
    cluster.effect[j] ~ dnorm(0, prec.cluster.common)
  } 


  d[1] <- 0 
  
  beta.baseline ~ dnorm(0, 10)
  beta.age ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)
  beta.gender ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)
  beta.empl_bin ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)
  beta.stc_bin ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)
  beta.edu_bin ~ dnorm(0, 0.01)

  for (k in 2:Nc) { # Loop da 3 a Nc, escludendo cIPD_2 (PE)
    d[k] ~ dnorm(0, 0.04)
  }

   lambda_baseline ~ dgamma(50, 9)
  lambda ~ dgamma(2, 15)
  for (k in 2:Nc) { 
    gamma.base[k] ~ ddexp(0, lambda_baseline)
    gamma.age[k] ~ ddexp(0, lambda)
    gamma.gender[k] ~ ddexp(0, lambda)
    gamma.empl_bin[k] ~ ddexp(0, lambda)
    gamma.stc_bin[k] ~ ddexp(0, lambda)
    gamma.edu_bin[k] ~ ddexp(0, lambda)
  }
for (i in 1:Npatients) {
y.ipd.pred[i] ~ dnorm(muIPD[i], prec.pat)
}
  for (s in 1:Ns) {
    for (a in 1:2) {
      y.AD.pred[s, a] ~ dnorm(muAD[s, a], precisionAD[s, a])
    }
  }
}
"
```

```{r model, include=FALSE}
    gender_i <- as.vector(dataIPD$gender) 
    empl_bin_i <- as.vector(dataIPD$empl_bin) 
    edu_bin_i <- as.vector(dataIPD$edu_bin) 
    stc_bin_i <- as.vector(dataIPD$stc_bin)
    cIPD_2_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_2"))
    cIPD_3_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_3"))
    cIPD_4_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_4"))
    cIPD_5_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_5"))
    cIPD_6_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_6"))
    cIPD_7_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_7"))
    cIPD_8_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_8"))
    cIPD_9_i <- as.matrix(get("cIPD_9"))
    cluster_indicator_jags <- ifelse(N_clusters_per_study_IPD_jags > 1, 1, 0)
    y_i <- matrix(dataAD2$y, nrow = 4, ncol = 2)
    n_AD_i <- matrix(dataAD2$n_AD, nrow = 4, ncol = 2)
    sd_AD_i <- matrix(dataAD2$sd_AD, nrow = 4, ncol = 2)
    cAD_2_i <- as.matrix(get("c2"))
    cAD_3_i <- as.matrix(get("c3"))
    cAD_4_i <- as.matrix(get("c4"))
    cAD_5_i <- as.matrix(get("c5"))
    cAD_6_i <- as.matrix(get("c6"))
    cAD_7_i <- as.matrix(get("c7"))
    cAD_8_i <- as.matrix(get("c8"))
    cAD_9_i <- as.matrix(get("c9"))

  
  data_jags <- list(
    y.ipd = as.vector(dataIPD$endpoint),
  studyIPD = studyIPD_i,
    arm = as.vector(dataIPD$arm),
    clusterID = clusterID_jags, 
  Nclusters = Nclusters_global, 
  cluster_indicator = cluster_indicator_jags,
  cIPD_2 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_2")),
  cIPD_3 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_3")),
  cIPD_4 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_4")),
  cIPD_5 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_5")),
  cIPD_6 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_6")),
  cIPD_7 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_7")),
  cIPD_8 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_8")),
  cIPD_9 = as.matrix(get("cIPD_9")),
    Npatients = Npatients,
    Ns.IPD = Ns.IPD,
  y = y_i,
        n = n_AD_i,
        sd = sd_AD_i,
  c2 = cAD_2_i,
        c3 = cAD_3_i,
        c4 = cAD_4_i,
        c5 = cAD_5_i,
        c6 = cAD_6_i,
        c7 = cAD_7_i,
        c8 = cAD_8_i,
        c9 = cAD_9_i,
  baseline = baseline_i,
        age = age_i,
        gender = gender_i,
        empl_bin = empl_bin_i,
        edu_bin = edu_bin_i,
        stc_bin = stc_bin_i,
  Ns=Ns,
    Nc = Nc
  )

  jags.m <- jags.model(textConnection(model1_con_AD_common_pct), data = data_jags, n.chains = 2, n.adapt = 500)
  params <- c("tau",  "tau.AD.extra", "tau.cluster.common", "d",  "beta.baseline", "gamma.base", "beta.age", "gamma.age",
                "beta.gender", "gamma.gender", "beta.empl_bin", "gamma.empl_bin",
                "beta.stc_bin", "gamma.stc_bin", "beta.edu_bin", "gamma.edu_bin", "y.ipd.pred", "y.AD.pred")
  closeAllConnections()
  samps_con_AD_lambda_con_AD_pct_temp <- coda.samples(jags.m, params, n.iter = 1000)

  samps_con_AD_lambda_con_AD_pct [[i]] <- samps_con_AD_lambda_con_AD_pct_temp

  saveRDS(samps_con_AD_lambda_con_AD_pct_temp, file = paste("samps_con_AD_lambda_no_Chibanda", i, ".rds", sep = ""))
}
```

```{r descaling, echo=FALSE}
get_descaled_samples <- function(beta_scaled_samples, original_sd = NULL) {
    if (is.null(original_sd)) {
        return(beta_scaled_samples)
    } else {
        return(beta_scaled_samples / original_sd)
    }
}

beta_baseline_samples <- all_chains_con_AD_lambda[, "beta.baseline"]
beta_age_samples <- all_chains_con_AD_lambda[, "beta.age"]
beta_gender_samples <- all_chains_con_AD_lambda[, "beta.gender"]
beta_empl_bin_samples <- all_chains_con_AD_lambda[, "beta.empl_bin"]
beta_stc_bin_samples <- all_chains_con_AD_lambda[, "beta.stc_bin"]
beta_edu_bin_samples <- all_chains_con_AD_lambda[, "beta.edu_bin"]

summarize_mcmc_effect <- function(samples, digits = 3) {
    mean_val <- mean(samples)
    ci <- quantile(samples, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
    return(sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)"), mean_val, ci[1], ci[2]))

)
results_df[nrow(results_df) + 1, ] <- c(

    summarize_mcmc_effect(effect_edu_bin_0_to_1, digits = 3)
)

print("Table of descaled results:")
print(knitr::kable(results_df, caption = "De-scaled Predictor Effects", align = c('l', 'l', 'c')))
```

```{r interaz, include=FALSE}

covariate_map <- list(
  baseline   = "base",      
  age        = "age",
  gender     = "gender",
  empl_bin   = "empl_bin",
  stc_bin    = "stc_bin",
  edu_bin    = "edu_bin"
)

sd_list <- list(
  baseline = NA,  
  age = sd_age_orig,
  gender = sd_gender_orig,
  empl_bin = sd_empl_bin_orig,
  stc_bin = sd_stc_bin_orig,
  edu_bin = sd_edu_bin_orig
)

extract_gamma_samples <- function(mat, var_pattern) {
  gamma_cols <- grep(paste0("^gamma\\.", var_pattern, "(\\[|$)"), colnames(mat), value = TRUE)
  if (length(gamma_cols) == 0) return(NULL)
  return(mat[, gamma_cols, drop = FALSE])
}

results_gamma_cont_df <- data.frame(
  Interaction = character(),
  Component = character(),
  `Coefficient (95% Credibility Interval)` = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (cov_real in names(covariate_map)) {
  cov_model <- covariate_map[[cov_real]]
  gamma_mat <- extract_gamma_samples(all_chains_con_AD_lambda , cov_model)
  if (is.null(gamma_mat)) next
  
  for (colname in colnames(gamma_mat)) {
    gamma_samples <- as.numeric(gamma_mat[, colname])
    
    if (is.na(sd_list[[cov_real]])) {
      gamma_descaled <- gamma_samples   
    } else {
      gamma_descaled <- gamma_samples / sd_list[[cov_real]]
    }

    mean_val <- mean(gamma_descaled, na.rm = TRUE)
    ci <- quantile(gamma_descaled, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
    
    component_name <- sub(".*\\[(.*)\\]", "\\1", colname)
    if (component_name == colname) component_name <- "(global)"
    
    results_gamma_cont_df[nrow(results_gamma_cont_df) + 1, ] <- c(
      paste(cov_real, "× component", sep = " "),
      component_name,
      sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", mean_val, ci[1], ci[2])
    )
  }
}

results_gamma_cont_df <- results_gamma_cont_df %>% arrange(Interaction, Component)

cat("Table of de-scaled interaction coefficients (CONTINUOUS OUTCOME):\n")
print(knitr::kable(
  results_gamma_cont_df,
  caption = "Covariate × Component Interactions (de-scaled, mean differences based on the mean)",
  align = c('l', 'l', 'c')
))
results_gamma_cont_df
```
